name: Korvain Dynamics Tactical Utility Belt
description:
A modular belt system with quick-detach pouches, magazine holders, and equipment loops. The belt's core is reinforced nylon webbing rated to support up to 15kg of distributed weight without sagging. Each pouch is individually accessible without disturbing adjacent equipment.

The standard load-bearing platform for private security, runners, and anyone who needs to carry more than their pockets allow. The belt comes unloaded — how it's configured says everything about what its wearer expects to encounter.
functionality: Modular equipment carrying, 15kg load rating, quick-access pouches
what_it_says: You carry your tools where you can reach them because reaching too slow has consequences.
story_hooks: A tactical belt found abandoned in an alley is configured for a very specific loadout — breaching charges, medical kit, and a pouch sized for a data core that was clearly the target of whatever operation the wearer was running.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian load-bearing harness worn at the waist. Projects an air of preparedness and capability—either corporate security or street-side operator. The belt reads as deliberately modular and functional, with visible attachment points and structured geometry rather than fashion-forward lines.
physical_description.fit: Worn snug at the natural waist or slightly lower depending on loadout. Designed to distribute weight evenly across the hips and lower back. Adjustable via friction-fit or magnetic retention system to accommodate various body types and layering underneath.
physical_description.primary_material: Industrial-grade reinforced nylon webbing with woven synthetic fibers rated for high tensile strength. Quick-release polymer attachment points and thermoplastic buckle components.
physical_description.texture: Densely woven, slightly stiff, with a matte finish. Seams are triple-stitched or bonded. The webbing shows a subtle grid pattern under close inspection. Pouch interiors lined with slick friction-resistant material.
physical_description.color_scheme: Base colors: tactical black, industrial gray, or dark charcoal. Often features contrasting accent stitching in high-visibility colors (neon cyan, safety orange, or blood-red) on seam work and loop edges. Worn examples show discoloration where pouches contact the body.
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty friction-fit webbing strap with magnetic latching backup. Quick-detach pouches use universal MOLLE-style connectors or proprietary snap systems. Buckle is reinforced polymer with redundant safety locks.
distinctive_features: Multiple load-bearing loops in staggered pattern across the front and sides
Quick-detach modular pouches (ammunition, tools, data storage, medical)
Integrated cable routing channels for weapon slings or shoulder harnesses
Hidden zippered security pocket for currency or credentials
Korvain Dynamics embossed logo badge—usually worn or obscured on street units
Adjustable sternum strap or chest harness attachment points
Weight distribution padding along the kidneys in premium models
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 functional. Expensive enough to signal competence and resources, but practical enough for working-class runners and private security. Not luxury, but clearly manufactured by a reputable corp (Korvain Dynamics). Budget models and knockoffs signal Tier 4–5 desperation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corporate security details, independent runners, black-market couriers, and anyone regularly operating outside safe zones. Signals preparedness, combat experience, or paranoia. In the GLMZ, wearing one unloaded is seen as either inexperience or statement-making.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in. Creases and wear patterns where pouches have been attached and reattached. Fading on sun-exposed areas. Metal components show patina or scratches. Well-maintained examples have reinforced stress points; neglected ones show fraying or loose webbing.
